findings.problem: Without a hint, "Ich lebe in Berlin und arbeite hier." is just as common and correct for "I live in Berlin", so the prompt has two right answers.

back.target: I live in Berlin and work here.
back.example: I live in Berlin and work here. And you?

note: The example sentence just repeats the phrase and adds "Und du?". That's fine, but it doesn't show the phrase in any new setting.
